stories.title: Boeing to cut about 5% of its commercial plane workforce
summary: Company will cut jobs through a mix of layoffs and attrition as it moderates the pace of ramping up jet productionBoeing will cut about 5% of its commercial plane workforce as it moderates the pace of ramping up jet production, the company said on Monday.The company will eliminate the posts through a mix of layoffs and attrition because of a slower ramp-up to “provide our factories and supply chain partners additional time to achieve stability”, said a message to employees from Boeing commercial chief Stephanie Pope.

stories.title: Chinese carmaker BYD’s offices in Netherlands raided over JLR ‘copycat car’ claim
summary: Bailiffs reportedly seized digital records before court case over alleged intellectual property breaches on Land Rover DefenderBailiffs acting for Jaguar Land Rover raided the Dutch offices of a Chinese “copycat” rival before a legal showdown this week over whether its “Defender clone” infringes intellectual property rights.Bailiffs acting on behalf of JLR reportedly seized digital records from the offices of Chinese carmaker BYD in Schiedam and Hoofddorp in August, according to the Sunday Times.
